budget_items.topic: American Legion 283 Fund annual disbursement policy
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Annual disbursement is set at 75% of interest earned at the current account balance

topics.topic: American Legion Post 283 Fund—Eligibility Standards and Governance
topics.resolution: Clarified eligibility standards; confirmed no cy pres filing required; reviewed fund governance and disbursement provisions
